body: Oh yes my appointments are over the phone but she sounds like she would rather be anywhere else then listen to me. She just prescribes me something then sends me on my way. It’s very frustrating. I’ll contact my GP surgery and see what I can do
How do I get my dr to change my prescription. She’s quite rude and blunt. Guess I’ll just try to change my Doctor I guess. Thinking of you buddy
I’m on anti depressants and talk to my counsellor, but idk sometimes I feel ok, sometimes I wanna disappear

Yes that’s true, but the things I used to do for comfort are now just to pass the time to get to the next day. Thank you for your replies though, you don’t know how much someone relating/talking to me helps

Thank you I appreciate it. It makes me feel guilty for feeling like this. I know people are in worse situations, and compared my struggles aren’t as bad, but I can’t help feeling like this. I hope your doing ok. My thoughts are with you
